info.title: Bot Center API
info.description: Gateway and bot engine in front of the WhatsApp provider. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details (`application/problem+json`) with a stable `code`. Write requests accept `Idempotency-Key`.

get.summary: Readiness: PostgreSQL, Redis, and the WhatsApp provider answer
Read a bot and its current version

200.description: The bot with its current version

429.description: Rate limit of the API key (`RATE_LIMITED`)

put.summary: Create a bot or publish a new version of its definition
put.description: `{id}` is a slug that the client chooses. A new version is published only when the definition changed. Open conversations stay on their version; new conversations use the new version. `instance_ids` is the full list of instances that the bot serves (an instance has at most one bot; an instance of another bot moves to this bot). A definition that is not valid gives 422 `BOT_DEFINITION_INVALID` with one error for each path. A key with an instance list gets 403 `INSTANCE_NOT_ALLOWED` when the bot serves an instance outside that list. The response of the create has `signing_secret` one time: it signs the `external` and `call_webhook` requests of the bot like a webhook. This route ignores Idempotency-Key, because the response can contain the secret.

200.description: The bot with its current version

422.description: The definition is not valid (`BOT_DEFINITION_INVALID`, `errors` has the paths)

429.description: Rate limit of the API key (`RATE_LIMITED`)

post.summary: Rotate the signing secret of a bot
post.description: Returns a new `signing_secret` one time. For 24 h, each `external` and `call_webhook` request of the bot has two v1= signatures (new and old). This route ignores Idempotency-Key, because the response contains the secret.

429.description: Rate limit of the API key (`RATE_LIMITED`)

get.description: Open it in the browser with `EventSource`. The token is the authorization (one use: a second open gets 401 `CONNECT_TOKEN_INVALID`). The first events are the latest `qrcode` or `pairing_code` and the current `status`; new codes and statuses follow. The stream closes after `status` `connected` or `logged_out`, and after `expired` (the end of the token). A comment line comes every 15 s. Close the `EventSource` after the last event: a reconnect gets 401. CORS: only the origins in `CONNECT_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`.

200.description: A stream of `ConnectEvent` (`event:` is the type, `data:` is the JSON)

post.summary: Move a conversation to a human or give it back to the bot
post.description: `human` stops the bot and removes the pending state timer. `bot` gives the conversation back to the bot and starts the timer of the current state again. A request that changes nothing returns the conversation without a new transition.

post.summary: Start the connection (QR code or pairing code)
post.description: Makes a one-use connect token (10 minutes) and revokes the older token of the instance. The browser opens `events_url` (Server-Sent Events). When the instance is already connected, the answer is 200 with `status` and no token. The route ignores `Idempotency-Key`. The provider is not available: 503 `PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` with `Retry-After`.

post.summary: Get a pre-signed upload URL for a media file
post.description: Send the bytes with `PUT upload_url`, the same `Content-Type`, and exactly `size_bytes` bytes before `expires_at` (5 minutes). Then use `media_id` in `POST /v1/messages`. The bucket is private. A tenant has at most `MEDIA_UPLOADS_PER_DAY` uploads for each UTC day and `MEDIA_MAX_BYTES_PER_TENANT` bytes of live files; above them, 429 `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`. Accepted types (image: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp; video: video/mp4, video/3gpp; audio: audio/aac, audio/mp4, audio/mpeg, audio/amr, audio/ogg; document: application/pdf, text/plain, text/csv, application/zip, application/msword, application/vnd.ms-excel, application/vnd.ms-powerpoint, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation). A `document` message accepts every type of the list.

get.summary: Get a fresh download URL of a media file
get.description: The `url` of an inbound file in a `message.received` event expires after 1 hour. This route gives a new signed URL (15 minutes) of a file of the tenant while the file is kept (`retentionDays`). A key with an instance list reads only the inbound files of its instances. An unknown or expired file is 404.

429.description: Rate limit of the API key (`RATE_LIMITED`)

post.description:
Queues one message and answers 202 at once. The worker sends it later; read the status with
`GET /v1/messages/{id}` or the `message.status` webhook event.

- `priority: reply` goes before `bulk` in the queue. The daily quota of the tenant
  (`maxMessagesPerDay`, UTC day) counts every message of this route; 429 `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` has
  `Retry-After` until 00:00 UTC.
- The instance must belong to the tenant (else 403). An instance without a WhatsApp session
  (`created`, `logged_out`) gives 409 `INSTANCE_NOT_CONNECTED`. A `connecting` or `disconnected`
  instance accepts the message; the worker retries for about 12 minutes, then the status is
  `failed` with `failure_reason: not_connected`.
- An instance has at most `OUTBOUND_MAX_QUEUED_PER_INSTANCE` (default 1000) `queued` messages.
  Above it, the answer is 429 `QUOTA_EXCEEDED` with `Retry-After: 60`.
- Each instance has a send rate (token bucket). A new number sends slower during its first days
  (warm-up). A message that waits for the rate limit stays `queued`.
- Delivery is at least once. When a send times out, the provider can have sent the message, and
  the retry (after 60 s or more) can send it a second time. After two such timeouts the status is
  `failed` with `failure_reason: send_timeout`.
- A media `url` must be a public HTTPS file. A URL that resolves to a private, loopback, link-local,
  or metadata address gives 422 `MEDIA_URL_FORBIDDEN`. The worker downloads the file (no redirects,
  at most 16 MiB, a WhatsApp file type in `Content-Type`) into the private bucket and sends the copy.
- `failure_reason` values: `invalid_recipient`, `instance_not_found`, `rejected`, `not_connected`,
  `provider_unavailable`, `send_timeout`, `instance_deleted`, `instance_not_connected`,
  `media_not_found`, `media_not_uploaded`, `media_url_forbidden`, `media_download_failed`,
  `media_too_large`, `media_type_not_accepted`, `internal_error`, `provider_error`,
  `instance_queue_full` (a bot reply above the queue limit), `expired` (still `queued` after
  `OUTBOUND_QUEUED_MAX_AGE_SECONDS`, default 24 h).
